explain: If Kela’s conditions are met, compensation is {pct} % of eligible outstanding higher-education loan above {threshold} €, with degree-based caps. Normally this concerns your first completed degree, first admission/attendance from {cohortDate}, and completion within Kela’s deadline. The cohort condition is first admission on or after {cohortDate}, or earlier admission with first registration as attending on or after that date. Earlier admission alone does not rule compensation out. Kela checks the first completed degree, completion time, eligible outstanding loan and degree-specific caps. Do not confuse this with income-tested student aid or repayment assistance.
